summary: Hampiðjan hf. produces and sells fishing gear and its components and ropes in Iceland. The company offers fishing products, including trawls, trawl doors, purse seines, warps and ropes, dynlce data and optical data, and netting products, as well as various hardware used for fishing. It also provides ropes for commercial fishing, seismic, mooring, tugging, yachting, lifting, leisure, and off-road. In addition, the company produces products for the oil industry, deep-sea projects, repair and renovation activities, and slings for heavy lifting; materials, ropes, and nets for fishing gear, as well as produce and sell tows and slings, nets, and aquaculture equipment. Hampiðjan hf. was founded in 1934 and is based in Reykjavik, Iceland.
